destinations.name: Kazakhstan
destinations.note: Central Asia's empty quarter — Charyn Canyon, steppe horizons, the Tian Shan foothills. Barely on anyone's circuit.

destinations.name: Finnish Lapland
destinations.note: Aurora season, reindeer country, silence you can actually hear. Go when the lakes are frozen solid.

destinations.name: The Dolomites, Italy
destinations.note: Via ferrata and rifugios above the treeline. Shoulder season, not the August crowds.

destinations.name: The American Wild
destinations.note: Still narrowing the region — the Tetons, the Pacific Northwest, Alaska's interior. One at a time, not a road-trip checklist.

destinations.name: Brazil
destinations.note: The Amazon basin over the beach towns — where the river is the road.

destinations.name: Peru
destinations.note: Machu Picchu is the excuse; the Andes and the trail in are the actual point.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.note: The outer atolls, not the resort strip off Malé. Empty sandbars over infinity pools.

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.note: National parks over Bangkok and Phuket — Khao Sok, the quiet islands nobody's flying into yet.

destinations.name: Japan
destinations.note: The Japanese Alps and Hokkaido's wilder north — still deciding which. Tokyo and Kyoto aren't the trip.

destinations.name: Hawaii
destinations.note: Big Island lava fields and Waipiʻo Valley over the Waikiki strip. Active ground, not a resort loop.

destinations.name: Austria
destinations.note: Hohe Tauern and the Grossglockner road — a different range and pace from the Dolomites next door.

destinations.name: France
destinations.note: The French Alps and Corsica's GR20 over the Chamonix tour buses — Mont Blanc without the queue.

destinations.name: Iceland
destinations.note: The interior highlands over the Ring Road — Landmannalaugar, Vatnajökull's ice caves, geothermal steam with nobody around.

destinations.name: Patagonia
destinations.note: Torres del Paine and the ice fields — the trekking capital of the far south, still mostly empty once you're past the first ridge.

destinations.name: New Zealand
destinations.note: Fiordland over Queenstown — Milford Track terrain without the day-trip buses.

destinations.name: Georgia
destinations.note: Svaneti's stone towers under 5,000-meter peaks — Europe's wildest mountains, barely discovered yet.

destinations.name: Faroe Islands
destinations.note: Eighteen islands, no crowds, cliffs that drop straight into the North Atlantic. Weather does whatever it wants.

destinations.name: Bhutan
destinations.note: The only country that caps visitor numbers on purpose — Himalayan wilderness that stays wilderness.

destinations.name: Mongolia
destinations.note: The Gobi's Flaming Cliffs and endless steppe — more horses than roads, more silence than anything else.

destinations.name: Namibia
destinations.note: Sossusvlei's red dunes and Etosha's waterholes — some of the darkest night skies left on Earth.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.note: The Louvre, Montmartre at dawn and long dinners. Go early to the big sights and spend the afternoons walking.

destinations.name: Rome
destinations.note: The Colosseum, the Forum and the Vatican, then trattorias in Trastevere. Two thousand years of history on every corner.

destinations.name: Amalfi Coast
destinations.note: Positano, Ravello and the Path of the Gods trail high above the sea. Lemon groves and swims off the rocks.

destinations.name: Barcelona
destinations.note: The Sagrada Família, the Gothic Quarter and a city beach in the same afternoon. Eat late, like the locals.

destinations.name: Lisbon
destinations.note: Tram 28 through Alfama, pastéis de nata and sunset viewpoints. Sintra and the surf coast are a short train away.

destinations.name: London
destinations.note: The British Museum, the South Bank and the markets. Most of the big museums are free.

destinations.name: Amsterdam
destinations.note: Canal houses, the Rijksmuseum and the Van Gogh Museum. Rent a bike and ride like a local.

destinations.name: Prague
destinations.note: The Charles Bridge at sunrise, Prague Castle and the Old Town square. A fairytale city center you can walk end to end.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.note: Oia's sunsets over the flooded volcano, black-sand beaches and the Fira to Oia cliff walk.

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.note: Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar and a ferry across the Bosphorus from Europe to Asia.

destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.note: The medina's souks, a riad courtyard and day trips into the High Atlas or out to the desert.

destinations.name: Cairo & the Pyramids
destinations.note: The Giza pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum and a felucca on the Nile. Add Luxor for the Valley of the Kings.

destinations.name: Petra & Wadi Rum
destinations.note: Walk the Siq to the Treasury, climb to the Monastery, then sleep under the stars in Wadi Rum.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.note: The Burj Khalifa, old Deira souks and a night in the dunes. Big, bright and easy to travel.

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.note: Hike up Table Mountain, drive the Cape Peninsula and see the penguins at Boulders Beach.

destinations.name: New York City
destinations.note: Central Park, the Brooklyn Bridge walk and a different neighborhood every day. Museums, food and energy nonstop.

destinations.name: Banff & the Rockies
destinations.note: Lake Louise, Moraine Lake and the Icefields Parkway: some of the most famous mountain scenery on Earth.

destinations.name: Swiss Alps (Zermatt)
destinations.note: The Matterhorn, car-free Zermatt and trains that climb to glaciers. Classic Alps, easy to reach.

destinations.name: Tokyo
destinations.note: Shibuya crossing, quiet shrines, the best food city in the world and day trips to Mount Fuji.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.note: Ubud's rice terraces, sunrise on Mount Batur, temples on the sea and some of the best surf in Asia.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.note: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay and hawker centers with Michelin-starred street food.

destinations.name: Sydney
destinations.note: The Opera House, the Bondi to Coogee coastal walk and ferries across one of the world's great harbours.

destinations.name: Great Barrier Reef
destinations.note: Snorkel or dive the world's largest reef from Cairns or Port Douglas, with the Daintree rainforest next door.

destinations.name: Rio de Janeiro
destinations.note: Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain and Ipanema beach, with rainforest right in the city.

destinations.name: Mexico City & Teotihuacan
destinations.note: Teotihuacan's pyramids at sunrise, the Frida Kahlo museum and some of the best tacos you will ever eat.

milestones.note: Dossier opened. Twenty places on the atlas so far, all favoring wild terrain over crowded ones. The plan: build the online business first, then spend real, extended stretches out in the world, with a home base that stays just as real.
